scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && PORT=4173 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/rgg-website run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && PORT=4174 BASE_PATH=/__mockup pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
